_doc: Config P (12/11) = O (configs/flow_final.json) + count_check + size_use_check + ticket_avg_check. count_check: a question that counts (hints 'counted': 'mấy lượt xe', 'bao nhiêu % tổng số máy') and names no money must not use a money by= metric (weekday_avg(p, d) / device_share(p) default to revenue) -> precheck error -> repair. Signal on every dev log (pub_full, tr_dev_all, d3sel, tr_dev_para; 115k samples): 192 hit, 0 right. size_use_check: the hints name a catalogue size ('sữa bột số 4') and the program neither calls size_qty nor names the size -> precheck error -> repair (85 dev samples hit, 0 right). ticket_avg_check: in a shop whose industry counts tickets (toolkit avg_ticket, 'sửa xe') aov(p) divides by every ticket incl. warranty -> precheck error, avg_ticket(p) (rulebook: money of a ticket / tickets with money; 140 dev samples hit, 0 right).
